story: Wind Creek State Park is a public recreation area located on the western side of Lake Martin, a reservoir on the Tallapoosa River in Alabama, USA. The state park occupies 1,445 acres.
matters: The park includes Lake Martin, a 41,000-acre reservoir on the Tallapoosa River, and features a trail system that was designated as a National Recreation Trail in 2011.
